Vendored libraries for artifact pages, served by the artifact origin at /_lib/<file> (server/artifacts/libs.ts) so pages
that use them work offline. Files are unmodified copies from the npm packages. Licenses: MIT (mermaid, chart.js),
BSD-3-Clause (vega, vega-lite, vega-embed); see LICENSE-<package>.

Mermaid 11 rather than 12: pages agents write ask for mermaid@10 or @11, and 11's single-file build is 3.6 MB against 5.5 MB.
/_lib/mermaid.esm.min.mjs is not a file here: libs.ts serves a few lines that load mermaid.min.js and export it, for pages that
`import mermaid from '.../mermaid.esm.min.mjs'`.

Updating: npm install --ignore-scripts <package>@<version> in a scratch folder inside the worktree, copy the file above, update
this table and the hashes, and the accepted major versions in libs.ts.
